features.name: Disciple of Life
features.desc: Your healing spells restore an additional 2 + the spell's level Hit Points.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.desc: When you heal another creature with a spell of level 1 or higher, you also regain 2 + the spell's level Hit Points.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.desc: When you roll dice to heal with a spell, you treat them as rolling their maximum.
